content:
**Skullbone Vantage** is a location in the Savage Divide region of Appalachia. It can be found directly north of the Top of the World, and northwest of the Pleasant Valley Cabins.

This encampment was set up as a Raider outpost sometime prior to 2102, but its inhabitants have since been wiped out. Many Raider corpses can still be found here. As of 2103, the Blood Eagles Raider gang occupies the area.

The camp is set up along a large, rocky cliff, and holds a number of tents and ski lifts turned into shelters. Next to two Snowshoes, a military trunk containing randomized loot can be found in the northern tent.

Skullbone Vantage appears in *Fallout 76*.
